title: Consolidate unseen failure signals and rework console dashboards + tracing
creator: Sofia Patel
description:
Summary: During the 2025-10-29 capacity/regression incident the Console team lacked several critical signals that delayed diagnosis and remediation. Missing per-tenant 95/99 tail latency, aggregated queue-depth spikes, and KV cache eviction counters combined with a sampling cliff in trace collection produced blind spots. Several dashboards surface misleading aggregates (mean latency across tenants) that masked a small set of tenants experiencing severe tail latency. The ingestion pipeline also dropped key metric dimensions during high cardinality bursts which prevented us from correlating request paths with KV cache misses and downstream throttling.

Scope: This ticket consolidates action items from the postmortem, prioritizes instrumentation changes, and outlines dashboard and tracepoint rework needed to restore full visibility and reduce MTTD for similar events. The work affects metrics ingestion (prom/OTel), trace sampling configuration, dashboard definitions in Grafana, and the Console alerting/runbook library.

Goals: 1) Ensure per-tenant and per-route tail-latency and kv-cache metrics are available during surges. 2) Remove misleading default aggregates and add percentile-focused dashboards. 3) Fix trace sampling cliff and add required span points for request-coldstart and kv-eviction paths. 4) Update runbooks and create playbooks tying metrics->traces->runbook steps for L2 on-call.
action_items: Add per-tenant 95th and 99th latency and kv-cache miss/eviction counters to the ingestion pipeline; ensure dimensions survive high-cardinality bursts (owner: Liam Chen; estimate: 5; due: 2025-11-14)
Instrument request lifecycle span points for 'request.dispatch', 'kv.cache.lookup', 'kv.cache.evict' and 'batching.wait' with consistent trace IDs (owner: Anika Rao; estimate: 3; due: 2025-11-13)

Adjust OTel trace sampler to a dynamic tail-sampling policy that increases retention for error/tail-latency traces and prevents the sampling cliff observed during the incident (owner: Marcus Green; estimate: 4; due: 2025-11-18)

Revise Console latency dashboards: remove mean-only panels, add per-tenant percentile heatmap, and add a KV-cache eviction time-series with tenant filter (owner: Design Ops / Dashboards, Emily Huang; estimate: 3; due: 2025-11-17)

Add aggregate queue-depth and client backpressure metrics to the alerts pipeline and create an alert playbook that maps alerts to targeted runbook steps (owner: SRE, Priya Nair; estimate: 2; due: 2025-11-12)

Patch ingestion pipeline to surface drop/log counts when dimensionality exceeds thresholds and create a dashboard that shows 'dropped-dimension' events for easier debugging (owner: Data Platform, Rahul Singh; estimate: 4; due: 2025-11-20)

Create a short postmortem appendix for Customer Success summarizing tenant impact and mitigation steps; include mitigation templates for customers affected (owner: Sofia Patel; estimate: 1; due: 2025-11-10)

Schedule a tabletop runbook exercise covering this failure mode and validate that metrics + tracepoints appear in <30 mins for on-call diagnosis (owner: Oncall Lead, Mateo Alvarez; estimate: 2; due: 2025-11-21)
